name: hanyu
description: A personal app for learning to read Chinese

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w shared && npm run seed:dev -w server
scripts.data:build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build:seed -w data
scripts.passages:generate: npm run build -w shared && npm run passages:generate -w data --
scripts.passages:check: npm run build -w shared && npm run passages:check -w data --
scripts.passages:translate: npm run build -w shared && npm run passages:translate -w data --
scripts.passages:review: npm run build -w shared && npm run passages:review -w data --
scripts.passages:coverage: npm run build -w shared && npm run passages:coverage -w data --
scripts.listening:generate: npm run build -w shared && npm run listening:generate -w data --
scripts.listening:check: npm run build -w shared && npm run listening:check -w data --
scripts.listening:review: npm run build -w shared && npm run listening:review -w data --
scripts.listening:coverage: npm run build -w shared && npm run listening:coverage -w data --
scripts.grader:learner-set: npm run build -w shared && npm run grader:learner-set -w data --
scripts.grader:eval: npm run build -w shared && npm run grader:eval -w data --
scripts.grader:consistency: npm run build -w shared && npm run grader:consistency -w data --
scripts.audio:generate: npm run build -w shared && npm run audio:generate -w data --
scripts.audio:sample: npm run build -w shared && npm run audio:sample -w data --
scripts.audio:status: npm run build -w shared && npm run audio:status -w data --
